literal: As rumor arises, precious life persists; that, many do not know, by good fortune.
translation: My precious life survives only because this rumor of our love arises; fortunately, the many who gossip do not realize this.
modern: அலர் (பழிச்சொல்) எழுவதால் என்னுடைய அரிய உயிர் நிலைத்து நிற்கிறது; அதனைப் பலர் அறியவில்லை, அது என் நல்வாய்ப்பே ஆகும்.
explanation: In this couplet, the heroine speaks of how the public rumor (alar) about her secret love actually sustains her life during separation. The gossip of the townspeople serves as a constant validation of her relationship, giving her the strength to endure the pain of absence. Ironically, those who spread the rumor do so to slander her, unaware that their gossip acts as a life-saving medicine. She considers this ignorance of theirs to be her own good fortune, as they would otherwise stop gossiping and she would lose her will to live.
